tools.name: find_x402_endpoints
tools.description: Ranks live x402 endpoints for a task such as 'web search', 'token price' or 'pdf to text'. Returns up to 10 endpoints ranked by text match, 7-day liveness probes and on-chain USDC payer counts. Not charged when nothing matches.

tools.name: x402_endpoint_card
tools.description: Trust card for one x402 endpoint URL: 7-day uptime from our probes, latency, last success, price, and the seller's on-chain USDC payers over 30 days. Not charged for unknown URLs.

tools.name: find_apify_actors
tools.description: Picks Apify Store actors for a scraping or automation task such as 'instagram posts' or 'google maps places'. Returns up to 10 actors ranked by text match, 30-day users and run success rate, with per-event price and an x402 run URL. Not charged when nothing matches.

tools.name: cartographer_status
tools.description: Free: price, network and data freshness of this server's paid tools.
